item.title: Solved: How to Securely Store Secret Keys and Passwords in Version Control Systems
item.description:
How to Securely Store Secret Keys and Passwords in Version Control Systems

Managing sensitive information like secret keys and passwords within version control systems (VCS) poses a significant challenge for developers. Keeping credentials secure while maintaining necessary access for development and production environments is paramount. This post explores various methods to secure your sensitive configurations, specifically tailored for use with Git and Django, ensuring that your secrets remain protected while staying version-controlled.
